title: Snake and Ladder Minimum Dice Throws
problemStatement: Given the positions of snakes and ladders on a game board numbered from 1 to N, determine the minimum number of dice throws required to reach the last cell.
input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains integer L. • Next L lines contain ladder start and end positions. • Next line contains integer S. • Next S lines contain snake head and tail positions.
output: Print the minimum number of dice throws.
